items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: You told us about your three brothers and you.

ctx.x: They must have dined in other place because they had their little hats on and things like that, but they would dance where the, where we were sitting, we just could see the dances.

I wanted to ask some more about the plantation down there. We talked to Sonny Henry a couple weeks ago. He couldn't remember who else was in the band. He said you'd know all of those fellas. You told us about your three brothers and you. Yeah. Do you remember who else? Some of the men.
Whenever they get the brothers' names. I know all the men that are in there, but they're not living.
